resources.string: Always-on VPN: %1$s Block connections without VPN: %2$s
Open Android Settings → Network → VPN manually.

Connect once first. In Android VPN settings, tap the gear beside Sahand VPN and explicitly enable BOTH “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN”. Always-on alone is not a kill switch. This app cannot enable these switches for you.
Android blocks non-VPN traffic while this VPN is unavailable, within the OS VPN contract. Disconnecting manually can leave the internet blocked until you reconnect or turn blocking off in Android settings.
Apps excluded from the VPN may lose connectivity under blocking; any OS exemption or VPN direct/bypass routing can weaken protection. Blocking does not make direct routes inside a working VPN private. The VPN app must reach its server outside the tunnel. No promise covers OS/OEM exceptions, tethering, or traffic before unlock.
Status is read from the running VPN service on Android 10+. If the service is stopped, or the API is unavailable, check Android settings; unknown does not mean off. No working saved connection? Internet can stay blocked until you disable blocking to search again.
